name: Consubterraneum
source:
A strange dream you've had since you were little? New friends? A new world to explore? Come and discover the world of Consubterraneum! You live in an artistic city called Maulun. What's special about this city is that it's underground, a kind of bunker. While everything is going well for you, you end up in an unknown and mysterious place that you'll discover with your new friends. Do you want to find out the truth behind everything that's happening to you, and maybe even more? Then take the necessary step to discover the history and secrets of Consubterraneum.

[From [url=https://aka-shinba.itch.io/consubterraneum]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你从小到大都做过什么奇怪的梦？新朋友？一个值得探索的新世界？快来探索Consubterraneum的世界吧！你住在一个叫毛伦的艺术城市。这座城市的特别之处在于它位于地下，有点像碉堡。虽然一切都很顺利，但你最终会和新朋友一起发现一个未知而神秘的地方。你想找出发生在你身上的一切背后的真相，甚至更多吗？然后采取必要的步骤来发现Consubterraneum的历史和秘密。

[来自[url=https://aka-shinba.itch.io/consubterraneum]Itch.io[/url]]
